Specification: This specification models a very small state machine with one variable x initialized to the constant N and incremented by 1 on each step. The comments indicate that the file is intended as a typechecking test: the constant N has a type annotation, while the variable x intentionally lacks one, so a typechecker should report the missing annotation. The module defines only an initial predicate and a next-state action; it contains no temporal specification, fairness assumptions, fault model, or proof content.
